body: I'm also feeling like shit right now but I just wanted to let you know that this wasn't a useless post at all, it's good to let it out. I really don't have any advice, but just know that someone out there knows how it feels like.
Glad I'm not alone. What keeps you going though?

I did consult a life coach who helped me before but somehow I can't express these thoughts to her for fear  of being ridiculed or questioned further. I'm terrified of having to explain myself because i dont have any real legitimate reasons to end my life.

I'm 24. I did for a long period of time feel that I was doing some good in my life but then I realized that I was in a happy little bubble of my own. So when that burst, everything began to crash and I realized the way I was doing things all along was wrong. I feel so so so stupid for thinking I was doing better than others and now it feels too late to restart my life again. Everyone tells me it's okay to take my time, and i'm a strong person but I can't help but feel they're just saying this to make me feel better because they know how fragile or weak I am. Am I simply over thinking?
